badges.name: Discord Staff
badges.description: Distinguishes confirmed full-time or contracted Discord employees and internal operations personnel.
badges.earning_method: Become an employed staff member at Discord Inc. Awarded by Discord internal directory administration. Automatically revoked upon departure.
eligibility_requirements: Employed by Discord Inc. as verified by internal HR systems
Assigned to corporate SSO and staff organizational unit
notes: Can be hidden by staff on public profiles if desired via account privacy settings.
Staff members may occasionally test features by attaching this badge to internal bot applications.

badges.name: Partnered Server Owner
badges.description: Awarded to owners of active, high-engagement communities accepted into the Discord Partner Program.
badges.earning_method: Apply and obtain approval for an eligible community server. If ownership is transferred, the badge transfers to the new server owner. New public applications were paused/re-evaluated after October 5, 2023.
eligibility_requirements: Must be the current designated owner of an accepted Discord Partnered Server
Server must uphold Partnership Community Guidelines and activity requirements
Account must have 2FA enabled
notes: Badge artwork underwent a vector redesign on May 31, 2022 from the original blue shield/star to modern geometric insignia.
Ownership transfer transfers the badge dynamically.

badges.name: HypeSquad Events Coordinator
badges.description: Recognizes community leaders who host or organize live in-person gaming conventions, tournaments, and local meetups.
badges.earning_method: Formerly applied through the HypeSquad Events application portal with proof of hosting local conventions or tournaments. Currently paused for new applicants.
eligibility_requirements: Historically required submitting video application and event attendance evidence
Must have maintained active event coordinator status without disciplinary strikes
notes: Distinct from the three in-client HypeSquad houses; granted via separate administrative review.
Coordinators received official event swag packages.

badges.name: Discord Bug Hunter (Tier 1)
badges.tier_threshold: Verified non-duplicate bug reports on Discord Testers
badges.description: Awarded to community testers who regularly discover, accurately report, and triage bugs on the official Discord Testers community.
badges.earning_method: Participate in the Discord Testers bug reporting community (via Discord Testers or Bug Hunter portal), successfully report valid and reproducible bugs, and reach the required community threshold.
eligibility_requirements: Membership in Discord Testers program
Consistent submission of reproducible, high-signal bug reports
Verification by Discord QA / Community managers
notes: Program access is restricted to select testing cohorts.
Green beetle icon signifies entry-level bug hunter milestone.

badges.name: HypeSquad Bravery
badges.tier_threshold: Complete in-app personality quiz resulting in House Bravery
badges.description: Represents membership in the House of Bravery, one of three community factions selected through the in-client quiz.
badges.earning_method: Go to User Settings > HypeSquad in the desktop or web client, take the 5-question personality aptitude test, and be assigned to Bravery.
eligibility_requirements: Any registered Discord account with access to Desktop or Web client User Settings
notes: Color theme is royal purple.
Users can retake the test at any time to switch houses or leave the program.

badges.name: HypeSquad Brilliance
badges.tier_threshold: Complete in-app personality quiz resulting in House Brilliance
badges.description: Represents membership in the House of Brilliance, focusing on patience, discipline, and tactical thinking.
badges.earning_method: Go to User Settings > HypeSquad in the desktop or web client, take the 5-question personality test, and match Brilliance answers.
eligibility_requirements: Any registered Discord account with access to Desktop or Web client User Settings
notes: Color theme is warm coral-orange.
Instantly obtainable for free without purchases.

badges.name: HypeSquad Balance
badges.tier_threshold: Complete in-app personality quiz resulting in House Balance
badges.description: Represents membership in the House of Balance, embodying harmony, stability, and mutual cooperation.
badges.earning_method: Go to User Settings > HypeSquad in the desktop or web client, complete the 5-question questionnaire, and match Balance outcomes.
eligibility_requirements: Any registered Discord account with access to Desktop or Web client User Settings
notes: Color theme is cyan / turquoise.
House of Balance won the Snowsgiving 2019 charity drive and received the temporary Golden Balance badge.

badges.name: Early Supporter
badges.description: Historical commemorative badge awarded to early patrons who purchased Nitro before the introduction of Nitro tiers.
badges.earning_method: Required a successful transaction or gift redemption for Discord Nitro prior to Wednesday, October 10, 2018 at 7:20:00 PM PDT.
eligibility_requirements: Completed a paid Discord Nitro transaction before October 10, 2018, 7:20:00 PM PDT
Account remained in good standing
notes: Permanent badge for existing holders. Can never be earned on newer accounts.
Features a retro gaming helmet/heart graphic.

badges.name: Discord Bug Hunter (Tier 2)
badges.tier_threshold: Distinguished exceptional contribution on Discord Testers
badges.description: Discord's highest technical testing accolade, awarded to top contributors who uncover critical vulnerabilities and triage complex regressions.
badges.earning_method: Granted directly by Discord QA leadership for extraordinary bug hunting achievements, exploit discoveries, and exceptional triage assistance.
eligibility_requirements: Prior attainment of Tier 1 Bug Hunter badge
Discovery of critical severity bugs or sustained multi-year triage leadership
Direct nomination and approval by Discord Security and QA teams
notes: One of the rarest obtainable badges in existence, held by fewer than an estimated 100 community members globally.

badges.name: Early Verified Bot Developer
badges.description: Commemorates developers whose applications reached 75+ servers and completed identity verification before the verification program overhaul.
badges.earning_method: Required owning a verified Discord bot with approved government ID verification prior to August 19, 2020.
eligibility_requirements: Owned a verified bot in at least 75 servers before August 19, 2020
Submitted government identity verification before the cutoff date
notes: Name was formally updated to include 'Early' on August 19, 2020, to distinguish early developer pioneers.
No new badges are awarded.

badges.name: Moderator Programs Alumni
badges.description: Recognizes community managers who passed the Discord Moderator Academy exam and served in the Discord Certified Moderator community.
badges.earning_method: Required studying the Discord Moderator Academy curriculum, passing the comprehensive exam, and maintaining good standing in the official DMC community before program restructuring.
eligibility_requirements: Passed Discord Certified Moderator exam prior to December 1, 2022
Active member of the Discord Moderator Discord server prior to archival
notes: Transitioned from 'Discord Certified Moderator' to 'Moderator Programs Alumni' on December 1, 2022.
Retained by past verified moderators.

badges.name: Active Developer
badges.description: Awarded to developers maintaining active applications that execute global application commands (slash commands) on Discord.
badges.earning_method: Own at least one active application that executed any global command within the last 30 days, visit Developer Portal > Active Developer Badge, select your app and support server, and claim the badge.
eligibility_requirements: Own at least 1 verified or unverified active application in Developer Portal
The app must have registered at least 1 global application command executed within 30 days
App must have Community Server support channel configured
Owner must visit discord.com/developers/active-developer to claim
notes: Requires continuous command activity; badges expire if no slash command execution is recorded over 60 days unless reclaimed.

badges.name: Originally Known As (Legacy Username)
badges.description: Displays a user's original legacy username and 4-digit discriminator (e.g. 'Originally User#1234') following the 2023 unique username rollout.
badges.earning_method: Awarded automatically to accounts that converted from the legacy discriminator system to unique handles during the 2023 rollout. Can be hidden in User Settings.
eligibility_requirements: Account existed before the May 2023 username migration
Successfully completed username migration
notes: Rendered as an interactive hoverable badge tooltip on profile cards revealing the original username#discriminator tag.

badges.name: Discord Nitro Subscriber
badges.tier_threshold: Active Nitro or Nitro Classic subscription
badges.description: Displayed on profile cards of accounts with an active paid Discord Nitro subscription.
badges.earning_method: Subscribe to Discord Nitro via desktop, web, or mobile app.
eligibility_requirements: Active paid subscription to Discord Nitro ($9.99/mo) or legacy Nitro Classic
notes: Reflects Nitro tenure milestone tooltip when hovered.
Artwork was streamlined in late 2024 to modernize the classic flying saucer rocket glyph.

badges.name: Discord Nitro Basic
badges.description: Denotes an active subscription to the lower-cost Discord Nitro Basic tier ($2.99/mo).
badges.earning_method: Subscribe to Discord Nitro Basic in User Settings > Nitro.
eligibility_requirements: Active paid Nitro Basic subscription
notes: Introduced alongside the phasing out of Nitro Classic.

badges.name: Nitro Tenure: Bronze
badges.description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 1 month.
badges.earning_method: Subscribe to Nitro and maintain the subscription past 30 continuous days.
eligibility_requirements: Active Discord Nitro subscription for >= 1 month
notes: Evolves as subscription duration increases.

badges.name: Nitro Tenure: Silver
badges.description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 3 months.
badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 3 months.
eligibility_requirements: Active Discord Nitro subscription for >= 3 months

badges.name: Nitro Tenure: Gold
badges.description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 6 months.
badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 6 months.
eligibility_requirements: Active Discord Nitro subscription for >= 6 months

badges.name: Nitro Tenure: Platinum
badges.tier_threshold: 12 continuous months of Discord Nitro (1 Year)
badges.description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 12 months (1 year).
badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 1 full year.
eligibility_requirements: Active Discord Nitro subscription for >= 12 months

badges.name: Nitro Tenure: Diamond
badges.tier_threshold: 24 continuous months of Discord Nitro (2 Years)
badges.description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 24 months (2 years).
badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 2 full years.
eligibility_requirements: Active Discord Nitro subscription for >= 24 months

badges.name: Nitro Tenure: Emerald
badges.tier_threshold: 36 continuous months of Discord Nitro (3 Years)
badges.description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 36 months (3 years).
badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 3 full years.
eligibility_requirements: Active Discord Nitro subscription for >= 36 months

badges.name: Nitro Tenure: Ruby
badges.tier_threshold: 60 continuous months of Discord Nitro (5 Years)
badges.description: Awarded after maintaining an active continuous Discord Nitro subscription for 60 months (5 years).
badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 5 full years.
eligibility_requirements: Active Discord Nitro subscription for >= 60 months

badges.name: Nitro Tenure: Opal
badges.tier_threshold: 72+ continuous months of Discord Nitro (6+ Years)
badges.description: Discord's ultimate subscription longevity honor, awarded for over 72 continuous months (6+ years) of active Nitro subscription.
badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous Nitro subscription for 6 or more years without lapse beyond grace period.
eligibility_requirements: Active Discord Nitro subscription for >= 72 months
notes: Replaces the older conceptual Fire/Flame legacy design.

badges.name: Server Booster: Level 1 (1 Month)
badges.description: Initial server boosting milestone badge displayed on user profiles and in the server booster list.
badges.earning_method: Apply a Server Boost to any guild and maintain it active.
eligibility_requirements: Apply and keep 1 active server boost slot
notes: Discord allows a 72-hour grace period if a boost lapses before resetting the streak.

badges.name: Server Booster: Level 2 (2 Months)
badges.description: Second server boosting milestone, updating the jewel insignia design.
badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 2 months.
eligibility_requirements: Continuous server boost for >= 2 months

badges.name: Server Booster: Level 3 (3 Months)
badges.description: Third server boosting milestone.
badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 3 months.
eligibility_requirements: Continuous server boost for >= 3 months

badges.name: Server Booster: Level 4 (6 Months)

badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 6 months.
eligibility_requirements: Continuous server boost for >= 6 months

badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 9 months.
eligibility_requirements: Continuous server boost for >= 9 months

badges.name: Server Booster: Level 6 (1 Year)
badges.description: Sixth server boosting milestone celebrating 1 full year of continuous boosting loyalty.
badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 12 months.
eligibility_requirements: Continuous server boost for >= 12 months

badges.name: Server Booster: Level 7 (15 Months)
badges.description: Seventh server boosting milestone.

badges.name: Server Booster: Level 8 (18 Months)

badges.name: Server Booster: Level 9 (2 Years+)

badges.earning_method: Maintain continuous server boost for 2 full years without lapse.
eligibility_requirements: Continuous server boost for >= 24 months
notes: Currently the pinnacle level in the boosting streak progression sequence.

badges.name: Supports Commands
badges.description: Indicates that an application utilizes Discord's official slash command and contextual interaction architecture.
badges.earning_method: Register at least one application command via Discord's REST API endpoint (/commands).
eligibility_requirements: Application has registered at least 1 global or guild application command
notes: Displayed on the application profile and in bot addition modals.

badges.name: Uses AutoMod
badges.description: Awarded to security and moderation bots that have created over 100 active AutoMod rules across servers.
badges.earning_method: Implement Discord's AutoMod API and maintain at least 100 active configured AutoMod rules across guilds.
eligibility_requirements: Created and actively maintain >= 100 AutoMod rules via Discord API
notes: Represents safety infrastructure support in the developer ecosystem.

badges.name: Server Has App Premium
badges.description: Appears on apps and bot profiles in servers where a paid subscription or monetization SKU has been purchased through Discord Premium Apps.
badges.earning_method: Users in a server purchase an official In-App Purchase SKU for that application via Discord's native billing system.
eligibility_requirements: App must be enrolled in Discord App Monetization
At least 1 active guild subscription purchased
notes: Shows a sparkling badge indicating active premium guild tier.

badges.name: Partnered Server
badges.description: Insignia rendered on server headers and discovery cards designating an officially Partnered Discord guild.
badges.earning_method: Achieve and maintain Discord Partner status for the guild.
eligibility_requirements: Server accepted into Discord Partner Program

badges.name: Verified Server
badges.description: Green/white verification checkmark on server headers for officially verified game studios, publishers, and recognized organizations.
badges.earning_method: Submit official verification request with corporate identity and domain verification.
eligibility_requirements: Verified corporate brand, esports organization, or game studio

badges.name: Official Discord Staff Server
badges.description: Official badge reserved for internal and corporate Discord servers owned and administered by Discord staff.
badges.earning_method: Internal corporate infrastructure only.
eligibility_requirements: Created and managed directly by Discord Inc.

badges.name: Community Server
badges.description: Denotes that a guild has enabled Community features (welcome screen, announcement channels, AutoMod, and stage channels).
badges.earning_method: Enable Community in Server Settings.
eligibility_requirements: Meet community safety standards and designate safety channels

badges.name: Discoverable Public Server
badges.description: Insignia for servers listed in public Server Discovery.
badges.earning_method: Meet Server Discovery requirements (1,000+ members, safety rules, no NSFW, etc.) and enable discovery in settings.
eligibility_requirements: >= 1,000 members
Active moderation
Compliance with Discovery terms

badges.name: Boosted Server (Level 0)
badges.tier_threshold: At least 1 boost, but under Level 1 threshold
badges.description: Appears on guilds that have received at least 1 boost but have not yet reached the 2-boost threshold for Level 1.
badges.earning_method: Receive 1 boost on the server.
eligibility_requirements: At least 1 active boost on server

badges.name: Boosted Server (Level 1)
badges.description: Indicates the server has attained Boost Level 1 unlocking 50 extra emoji slots, 720p 60fps Go Live, 128 Kbps audio, and custom invite background.
badges.earning_method: Accumulate and maintain 2 active server boosts.
eligibility_requirements: >= 2 active server boosts

badges.name: Boosted Server (Level 2)
badges.description: Indicates Level 2 server boosting unlocking server banner, 256 Kbps audio, 50MB upload limit, and 1080p 60fps streams.
badges.earning_method: Accumulate and maintain 7 active server boosts.
eligibility_requirements: >= 7 active server boosts

badges.name: Boosted Server (Level 3)

badges.earning_method: Accumulate and maintain 14 active server boosts.
eligibility_requirements: >= 14 active server boosts

badges.name: Server Owner Crown

badges.earning_method: Create a server or receive ownership transfer. Automatically hides if a hoisted role grants Administrator permissions to prevent targeted harassment.
eligibility_requirements: Must be designated Guild Owner

badges.name: I'm New Here, Say Hi!

badges.earning_method: Join a Community server with new member greeting features enabled.
